title: The Rubber Duck Convoy on U.S. 58
summary: On Monday, March 16, 2015—the day before the guardianship hearing in Norfolk Circuit Court—the Bluewater and Christiansburg contingents unite into a three-vehicle Rubber Duck Convoy rolling east across Virginia down U.S. Route 58 to Norfolk.
